notes: Mags Oakum's Patient Ann from Briar Glen Quay to Kestrel Lock (downriver, 12 game hours: the lock is halfway to Wendmouth, whose full downriver run is one game day), mw-e25.33. Mornings only (05:00 to 12:00) and only from the morning after the first night (time.day 2 or later): at night she will not run, 'not with whatever's singing up there' (bible 3.6). Sold through mags-patient-ann. Four crowns, as her dialogue always quoted.
name: Passage to Kestrel Lock
